policy.facts: Audited filings and exchange announcements take precedence.
policy.management_claims: Speeches, press releases and company rankings are labeled as management claims unless independently corroborated.
policy.public_proxies: Store ratings, chart snapshots, install bands and website visits are not treated as MAU, paying users or audited revenue.
policy.hashes: snapshot_sha256 is supplied where a local research snapshot was frozen; null means a live web page was cited without a tracked local copy.
policy.investment_boundary: Scenario analysis is not a target price or buy/sell instruction.
